description: This file defines UI components and caching mechanisms for session preview in a macOS app, including cache management, preview loading, and SwiftUI views for displaying session message previews.

classes.name: SessionPreviewItem
classes.description: Represents a preview item with an ID, role, and text.

classes.name: PreviewRole
classes.description: Enumerates roles (user, assistant, tool, system, other) with label descriptions.

classes.name: SessionPreviewCache
classes.description: Singleton actor managing cached session preview snapshots with methods for retrieval and testing.

classes.name: SessionPreviewLimiter
classes.description: Singleton actor controlling concurrent access to preview requests with permit acquisition and release.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewSnapshot
classes.description: Data structure holding preview items and load status.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewView
classes.description: SwiftUI view for displaying session message previews with different load states.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewLoader
classes.description: Static class handling prewarming, loading, and fetching session preview snapshots with caching and timeout logic.

methods.name: cachedSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a cached snapshot if within max age.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a snapshot in cache for a session key.

methods.name: lastSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves the last snapshot for a session key.

methods.name: withPermit
methods.description: Acquires a permit for concurrent operations, executes an async operation, then releases.

methods.name: _testSet
methods.description: Test method to set cache entry manually.

methods.name: _testReset
methods.description: Test method to reset cache entries.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a session preview snapshot, using cache if available.

methods.name: prewarm
methods.description: Preloads session previews for multiple session keys.

methods.name: fetchSnapshot
methods.description: Fetches a session preview snapshot, falling back to history if needed.

methods.name: requestPreview
methods.description: Requests a preview payload from the server with timeout control.

methods.name: fetchHistorySnapshot
methods.description: Fetches chat history for a session as a fallback preview.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot from a list of preview items.

methods.name: snapshot(from: maxItems:)
methods.description: Creates a snapshot from a session entry, interpreting status.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Caches preview payload entries.

methods.name: previewLimit
methods.description: Calculates limit for preview items.

methods.name: normalizeMaxItems
methods.description: Normalizes max items to a bounded range.

methods.name: previewItems(from: maxItems:)
methods.description: Builds preview items from session entry.

methods.name: previewItems(from: maxItems:)
methods.description: Builds preview items from chat history payload.

methods.name: decodeMessages
methods.description: Decodes raw message data into chat message objects.

methods.name: previewRole
methods.description: Determines role enum from raw string and tool flag.

methods.name: previewRoleFromRaw
methods.description: Converts raw string to role enum.

methods.name: previewText
methods.description: Generates preview text from a chat message.

methods.name: isToolCall
methods.description: Checks if a message involves a tool call.

methods.name: toolNames
methods.description: Extracts tool names from a message.

methods.name: mediaSummary
methods.description: Summarizes media content in a message.

methods.name: dedupePreservingOrder
methods.description: Removes duplicates from a list while preserving order.

methods.name: uniqueKeys
methods.description: Deduplicates and trims session keys.

methods.name: isUnknownMethodError
methods.description: Checks if an error indicates an unknown method response.
